label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y si acerques minjá de primicias a Jehová, Aviv tostado en el fuego, grosero de karmel acercarás la minjá de tus primicias.
spanish: Y si acercas ofrenda de primicias a Jehová, espiga tierna tostada en el fuego, grano triturado de espiga fresca acercarás la ofrenda de tus primicias.
grammarChanges: Translated minjá (h03002014003, h03002014013) to the Spanish noun ofrenda.
Translated Aviv (h03002014006) to the common noun espiga tierna instead of a capitalized proper name; changed the participle tostado to tostada to agree in gender with espiga.
Translated grosero (h03002014009) from the adjective grosero to the noun phrase grano triturado de, matching the construct noun sense.
Translated karmel (h03002014010) to the common noun espiga fresca instead of leaving the untranslated Hebrew form.
Changed acerques to the indicative acercas (h03002014002); Spanish real si-conditionals take the indicative, not the subjunctive, and the person and hiphil stem force are unchanged.
readerNote: Chose the feminine noun espiga tierna for aviv, so the participle was adjusted to tostada to agree in gender; no clause roles or participants were changed.
